title: Tax Refund Conundrum - Help Me Decide

title: Winter Tires - Just Another Expense
body: I just got back from a 3-day road trip to visit my kids in the mountains. We hit some serious snow and ice on the way home, but I'm not convinced that winter tires would have made much of a difference. My old all-seasons did okay considering they were only 5 years old. If you're on a budget like I am now, maybe not worth shelling out for dedicated winters.

title: First fresh eggs from new girls in the backyard!
body: Just had to share my excitement - our three new hens have started laying! It's been a few months of trial and error, but it looks like they're finally settled in. We've got a mix of Rhode Island Reds and Barred Rocks, and I'm loving the variety in egg color and size. Nothing beats collecting fresh eggs from your own backyard - feels like we're getting closer to self-sufficiency!

title: Freezer Meal Prep for a Busy Farm Family
body: I've found that the key to successful meal prep is to use what you have on hand. Last week I made a big batch of chili with ground beef from our own farm, froze it in individual portions and now it's easy to just grab one out of the freezer for dinner. It's been a lifesaver on days when I'm too tired after working all day to think about cooking.

title: Old Laptop Saved from the Scrapheap
body: I just got an old laptop working again for my kid to use for school. It's a 2012 Dell, and I had to replace the power supply and clean out some dust, but it booted right up. title: Frustrating restoration project - parts just don't fit!
body: I've been working on this 1967 Ford Mustang for years now, and I'm getting to the point where I'm at my wit's end. Guess that's what I get for buying an old project car...

title: Land prices near cities are artificially inflated.
body: I've been trying to find a place to start my own small farm for years. Every plot I look at is way out of my budget, and most of it's within an hour of the city. It seems like land prices in these areas have skyrocketed because everyone wants to be close to their jobs or whatever. I think that's unsustainable. We need affordable land options if we want people to start farming for real.

title: Used up last week's chicken in a mean fried rice dish
body: I'm proud of myself for getting creative with leftovers. We had a big family dinner at my place on Sunday and there was more than enough food to go around, but I didn't want to waste any of it. So this morning I cooked up the leftover chicken with some veggies from the garden and made a massive plate of fried rice. The kids love it when we reuse ingredients like this.

title: Saved $300 by fixing my old laptop's screen instead of buying a new one
body: I'm on night shift at the hospital right now, but yesterday I was struggling to get work done because my laptop's screen had cracked. I'd been putting off fixing it for months, but I finally took some time to look up YouTube tutorials and ordered a replacement screen online. It wasn't as hard as I thought it would be, and now I have a functional computer again instead of breaking the bank on a new one.

title: Finally a budget that works for me
body: Just made it through my first month on my own after 25 years of marriage. I've been struggling to make ends meet since the split, but this month's budget was a game changer. title: Don't buy a new car for your first road trip
body: I just bought my first real car and took it on its maiden voyage. I was expecting to love every minute of driving a brand new vehicle, but honestly the experience was overhyped. The road noise was annoying, the seats weren't as comfortable as I thought they'd be, and the features that seemed so cool in the showroom were just distractions on the open road.
